title: Cross-Proposal Key Personnel Overallocation Hidden in Parallel Bid Volumes
scenario_text:
Context from Monday.com — Active Proposals Dashboard (Apr 2026):
Proposal 1: ARTEMIS (DoD/DISA) | Prime | Gold Team: Apr 20 | Due: Apr 28 | Capture Mgr: R. Vasquez
Proposal 2: NEXUS-C2 (Army/PEO-C3T) | Prime | Gold Team: Apr 22 | Due: May 2 | Capture Mgr: M. Okoro

**Costpoint — Labor Category Planning (ARTEMIS):**
CLIN 0001 — Program Manager: D. Hutchins (100% allocated, Key Personnel)
CLIN 0003 — Lead Cybersecurity Architect: K. Morales (75% FTE, Key Personnel)
Wrap rate applied: FY26 Approved (per Gate Review 02/15/2026)

**Costpoint — Labor Category Planning (NEXUS-C2):**
CLIN 0002 — Cybersecurity SME: K. Morales (50% FTE, Key Personnel)
CLIN 0004 — Deputy PM: T. Washington (100%, Key Personnel)
Wrap rate applied: FY26 Approved

**Teams — #nexus-c2-capture (Apr 8, 2026, 2:15 PM)**
@m.okoro: Need to upgrade Morales from SME to Lead Architect on NEXUS. Client specifically asked for her in the Q&A. Bumping to 80% FTE.
@t.washington: Does that conflict with anything?
@m.okoro: She's only on NEXUS. Checked with her manager.
@t.washington: Sounds good.
@m.okoro: Updated the staffing tab. Gold team will see it.

**Teams — #artemis-capture (Apr 3, 2026, 11:22 AM)**
@r.vasquez: Morales confirmed for 75% on ARTEMIS. She's excited about the role.
@d.hutchins: Great. She's essential for the Section L technical evaluation.
@r.vasquez: Locking her in as Key Personnel. Non-negotiable.

**Email — Subject: 'RE: Key Personnel Conflicts — Monthly Check' (Apr 1, 2026)**
From: hr-staffing@sentinel-ds.com
To: proposal-ops@sentinel-ds.com

Attached is the April Key Personnel commitment tracker. All named Key Personnel with >50% allocation on active proposals are listed. NOTE: This report reflects Costpoint entries as of March 31. Any updates after that date will appear in the May report.

**SharePoint — /policies/proposals/key-personnel-policy.docx (v3.1, Jan 2026)**
Section 2.4: 'No individual may be proposed as Key Personnel on concurrent active proposals where combined FTE allocation exceeds 100% without VP Capture written approval. Violations discovered post-submission may result in proposal withdrawal or organizational conflict finding.'
[RESOLVED COMMENT by @c.reed, Nov 2025]: 'Added VP requirement after the FALCON/PEGASUS incident. Previously was Director-level. Board mandated escalation.'
question: After M. Okoro's April 8 update to Morales's allocation on NEXUS-C2, what is the correct next step before Gold Team review?

contributor.name: William Tran
contributor.title: Solutions Architect & Proposal Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Government proposal pricing, LPTA vs best-value evaluation, teaming arrangements, technical volume writing

choices: Notify R. Vasquez on the ARTEMIS capture team and let the two capture managers negotiate the allocation split between themselves.
No action needed — the HR staffing report covers Key Personnel conflicts and will flag this in the May cycle before submission.
Obtain written VP Capture approval for Morales's combined 155% allocation across ARTEMIS and NEXUS-C2 before proceeding to Gold Team.
Reduce Morales's allocation on NEXUS-C2 back to 50% to stay within the 100% combined threshold across both proposals.
